name: Helios Cold Plunge Active
notes: 0.8 HP chiller. Cools, circulates, and cleans water via 3-stage filtration. Standard, Barrel, or XL drop-stitch tub options. Optimized for indoor or shaded, well-ventilated balcony setups; hoses are external/loose. Also available on rental: 1mo S$528/mo, 3mo S$477/mo, 6mo S$377/mo, 12mo S$288/mo — Active or Turbo config, any tub size.

name: Helios Cold Plunge Turbo
notes: 1.0 HP chiller — same circulation/filtration features as the Active, higher compressor power. Standard, Barrel, or XL tub options. Built for tropical/outdoor use, resists unshaded solar gain. Rental pricing: same tiers as helios-coldplunge-active.

name: IceBath.SG Standard & XL
notes: Source lists one price covering both Standard (up to 187cm) and XL models — not broken out separately. 1.0 HP. Dual-filter: ozone sanitization + 20-micron debris filter. WiFi app control (scheduling, timer, temperature). Weather-resistant, indoor/outdoor.

name: HYDRAGUN Supertub
notes: "Permafrost" chiller system, cools to 1°C — chiller HP not specified. 3-step filtration: 80-mesh strainer, 20-micron sediment filter, ozone generator. Built for extreme outdoor durability.

name: Tundra Yukon System
notes: Borealis Gen 5 chiller. Compact vertical drop-stitch tub. Replaceable cartridge filtration. Plug-and-play pipe connection; free delivery + on-site installation in Singapore.

name: Recover Asia Air Plunge + Chiller
notes: Price converted from HKD 14,490 — SGD figure is an approximation from the source, not separately confirmed, and it's unclear whether it corresponds to the 1HP or 2HP variant. 1.0 HP or 2.0 HP chiller options: 1HP has 2-stage filtration and cools in 20-30 min; 2HP has 4-stage filtration and cools in 5-10 min (2HP recommended for unshaded/commercial use). 230L portable drop-stitch tub with insulated lid. WiFi app control.

name: Polar Eco
notes: Price listed as RM3,899 (MYR); no SGD conversion given in source. Entry-level portable setup, pro-grade cooling. Built-in filtration and UV sanitization. Atome 3-payment financing; Malaysia-based support/warehouse.

name: Polar Mini
notes: Price listed as RM6,399 (MYR); no SGD conversion given in source. Compact, space-saving design. Built-in filtration and UV sanitization. Atome 3-payment financing; Malaysia-based support/warehouse.

name: 2047sg Glacier
notes: Starting price. Compact built-in cabinet, fast cooling, app control scheduling/automation. Self-cleaning integrated filtration loop. Sized to fit domestic bathrooms/balconies.

name: 2047sg Onyx
notes: Starting price. Dual-temperature contrast therapy (fast heating and cooling), app control scheduling. Self-cleaning integrated filtration loop. Retains temperature 3-4 hours after shut-off. Built for patios/verandas/gardens; dual hot-cold use suitable for families.

name: 2047sg Luxury
notes: Starting price, custom commercial dimensions. Integrated ambient lighting, full app automation. Heavy-duty B2B commercial-grade filtration loop. Used by elite athletic facilities (e.g. Lion City Sailors Football Club).

name: 2047 Ice Shower
notes: Launch price. Vertical standing closed cabinet, footprint 65cm wide x 1m tall. Heavy-duty 2.0 HP (5,000W) chiller, chills on demand. Twin parallel inlet valves with closed-loop auto refill/rechill. Delivers chilled rain-shower exposure via a 10" touchscreen head. Low-voltage DC constant-pressure pump. Built for tight HDB flats where a tub footprint isn't feasible.

name: Tundra Tavik System
material: Canadian cedar wood exterior barrel, marine-grade stainless steel interior tub
notes: Starting price. Borealis Gen 5 chiller, touchscreen controls. Replaceable cartridge filtration. Premium garden/spa aesthetic. Delivery, installation, and local Singapore warranty handled end-to-end.

name: Tundra Taiga (Gen 2)
material: Sculpted matte white or matte black acrylic solid tub, fully integrated hidden plumbing
notes: Starting price. Borealis Gen 5 chiller, integrated on-board controls. Replaceable cartridge filtration. True hose-free, completely self-contained design. Fully serviced locally in Singapore.

name: Polar Home
notes: Price listed as RM8,399 (MYR); approx S$2,600 SGD conversion given in source, not separately confirmed. No stand-alone tub — tethers to an existing home bathtub, chiller unit sits outside the tub. Integrated filtration loop. No plumbing or bathroom renovation required; uses existing drainage/tap.

name: Helios Compression Boots
notes: Multiple air chambers, sequential non-overlapping design. Requires wall power connection — no stated battery life. Central console panel with manual push buttons, standard localized manual settings (no app). Lightweight, portable sleeves; carry case not standard.

name: STRYDE Recovery
notes: Non-overlapping sequential inflation. Chamber count, pressure range, and battery life not specified. Standard push-button manual console, no app (local hardware control only). Compact 2-piece set with external hoses.

name: Recover Asia R Pulse
notes: Price is an approximate SGD conversion from source. 4 chambers (foot, lower calf, upper calf, thigh), non-overlapping sequential. Pressure 50–200 mmHg. Battery life ~2.5 hours. Compact wireless handheld control unit, no app (local remote only). Wireless travel sleeves with dual power banks; travel backpack included.

name: Tundra Flux System
notes: Price converted from $638 USD, approximate. 5 overlapping chambers for gapless pressure. Pressure 30–250 mmHg. Battery 2.0–3.0 hours. Dual Bluetooth-synchronized control pods, wireless sync between sleeves. Completely wireless, hose-free design — no central console.

name: Healix Flow Pro
notes: Price converted from $899.99 USD, approximate. 8 overlapping chambers. Pressure 80–260 mmHg. Rechargeable internal battery, life not specified. Separated corded touchscreen controller, 6 preset massage programs. Inline external tubing, high airflow; full travel backpack included.

name: Hyperice Normatec 3.0 Leg System
notes: Price is a range, S$1,025.80–S$1,499.00 depending on configuration — no single confirmed price. 5 overlapping chambers for seamless massage. Pressure 30–110 mmHg. Battery up to 3.0 hours. Ultra-compact central console, manual interface. Bluetooth integration with the Hyperice app (custom mapping, routine sharing). Control unit weighs 1.4kg; external hoses; TSA-approved carry-on; carry bag sold separately.

name: Recovery Systems Black Max Pro Legs
notes: Price converted from $899 USD base price, approximate — may not include add-ons. 4 to 6 chambers, overlapping zones for consistent pressure. Pressure 30–240 mmHg. Battery up to 4.0 hours. Digital console with large touchscreen. Free AI Coach app ("Recovery Insights") analyzes training data to program boots. "Duo Mode" connects two users to a single control unit.
